purpose: self-directed formative study with fragmented mobile use
progression: structural-completion; no mastery claim; learner can continue or reveal without penalty
sequencing: fixed authored microsequence order; declared soft dependencies; learner selects course/step
pacing: learner-paced; no card timer or ordinary deadline
review: author-placed reprises plus learner-marked review; no adaptive scheduler
examples_scaffolding: author-provided examples when needed; guided-to-independent progression; learner-requested local support
segmentation_resumption: meaningful microsequences and ordered cards; cursor, breadcrumb and direct resume
authority: author defines course structure; learner controls pace and ordinary review; accessibility overrides
p1_interaction: low-consequence practice; structural progress separate from correctness; attempt telemetry off
recommendation: preserve as first complete reference profile, not universal default

purpose: personal study with recommendations but no coercive mastery gate
progression: structural completion plus optional self-check and learner-visible readiness recommendation
sequencing: recommended path with soft prerequisites and learner override
review: explicit spaced schedule with free deferral, load cap and learner priority
examples_scaffolding: examples available on request; scaffold restoration; optional equivalent items
segmentation_resumption: learner-paced segments; reentry menu: resume, brief review or preview next
p1_interaction: feedback and reveal remain formative; no grades/ranking
recommendation: recommended alternative for personal mastery-oriented use

purpose: formal formative course with criterion-referenced progression
progression: criterion-gated by declared evidence, threshold, window, remediation and recheck; not one universal threshold
sequencing: prerequisite-topological or authored path; controlled override and remediation branch
pacing: shared pace with deadlines and accommodations
review: course-defined spacing, reassessment windows, load budget and documented deferral
examples_scaffolding: novice examples, completion problems, criterion-linked but restorable fading
segmentation_resumption: meaningful modules with status and next action; interruption-safe resume
authority: institution/course author; accessibility and due process override; learner choices within permitted space
p1_interaction: multiple attempts and feedback governed by course policy; score/consequence explicit
recommendation: accept as profile; require workload, completion, appeal and fairness policies

progression: institution/protocol release based on calibrated evidence; structural completion never sufficient
sequencing: hard prerequisites only when construct and consequence justify them; explicit exception/appeal
pacing: institution-paced with accommodations and rescheduling rules
review: separate preparation/review from scored assessment; reveal delayed according to policy
examples_scaffolding: support in learning phase; assessment support defined as accommodation or permitted aid
segmentation_resumption: assessment states preserve input and allow safe recovery without altering validity
authority: institution subject to law, accessibility, consent and appeal
p1_interaction: evaluation authority, credit, attempts and consequences explicit
recommendation: represent, but do not use as product default; validity belongs to #5/#6

purpose: reproducible comparison of progression, sequence, review or support conditions
progression: protocol-defined and snapshotted; evidence and overrides recorded
sequencing: protocol-fixed or randomized within approved design; effective sequence snapshot
review: intervals, horizon, items, deferral and missed-review handling fixed by condition
examples_scaffolding: availability, position, fading and restoration locked by condition
segmentation_resumption: resume support fixed or randomized; condition-preserving recovery
authority: approved protocol and participant rights; accessibility exception has precedence
p1_interaction: attempt/reveal/feedback/consequence imported from P1 condition snapshot
recommendation: required conceptual profile for Issue #5 research design

purpose: reduce unnecessary search and cognitive load for low prior knowledge
progression: no automatic mastery implication; evidence may recommend additional guided practice
review: guided retrieval with feedback; equivalent instances introduced gradually
examples_scaffolding: complete worked examples, explanation and completion problems; gradual, reversible fading
segmentation_resumption: smaller coherent segments; explicit context and next step
authority: author/accessibility accommodation; learner may restore support
p1_interaction: hints and reveal available without punitive consequence
recommendation: recommended overlay for novel or complex structured tasks

purpose: avoid redundant guidance and preserve productive challenge for higher prior knowledge
progression: may use compact evidence or challenge items, but no hidden expertise inference
sequencing: greater learner choice and discriminative interleaving where domain evidence supports it
review: lower load, transfer-oriented or self-selected review
examples_scaffolding: condensed or optional examples; support remains restorable
segmentation_resumption: larger coherent chunks permitted; direct resume
p1_interaction: constructed/transfer responses may replace recognition when appropriate
recommendation: accept as overlay; expertise determination remains P3/P4 question

purpose: support worker-students studying in short, interrupted, sometimes offline sessions
progression: current structural state preserved without inferring mastery or disengagement
sequencing: clear current location, dependencies and next recommended action
pacing: learner-paced; pause and defer always available outside consequential windows
review: bounded queue, snooze/reschedule, offline availability and explicit missed-review policy
examples_scaffolding: support and examples available after resumption without forced branch
segmentation_resumption: cursor, breadcrumb, prior-goal cue, optional brief review/preview and preserved input
authority: learner and accessibility needs over convenience defaults
p1_interaction: no attempt/time telemetry by default; interruption is not failure
recommendation: recommended cross-cutting overlay for the first product recut
